I fixed both issues in `TRPCClientError.ts`. Both rules were pointing at the same problem: two separate `import type` statements from `@trpc/server/unstable-core-do-not-import` (lines 36–41 and line 43).

I moved `DefaultErrorShape` into the first `import type` block, kept the alphabetical order, and deleted the extra line. These are type-only imports, so runtime behavior is unchanged.

I kept the separate value import `import { isObject } ...` on its own line. Neither rule flagged it, so the linter accepts one type import and one value import from the same module.

I didn't run the linter, per the instructions; the file is re-linted when this finishes.
